name: University of Helsinki
description: The University of Helsinki is known as a university founded in the city of Turku in 1640. The university has been in Helsinki since 1829 and is considered Finland's oldest and largest university with the widest range of disciplines. The university is home to 11 faculties and 11 research institutes. It offers students undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degrees in a variety of disciplines. However, it hosts approximately 32 thousand students. The number of international students is known to be about 2,000 and this is one of the reasons why the University of Helsinki is among the best options for international students who want to study in Finland. Lastly, the university is also among the top 100 universities in the world.
